ache.title: Spending little is good. The loop is still there
ache.note: Nero plays Neverness to Everness with just the subscription, no battle pass, at his own pace and without rushing stamina. Real progress. But the banners are still here: a 90-pull guarantee, a 200-pull skin, 720 fragments for base characters. Those numbers are long roads built to keep you walking.
watch: a subscription that keeps you logging in
ache.tip: Keep your limit, and check in with yourself monthly: is this still fun, or just a routine?

textData.text: I share how I’m enjoying Neverness to Everness while spending very little—just the subscription and no battle pass—by playing at my own pace without FOMO. I show a quick freebie quest near Torchwood Avenue to photograph a paper plane and unlock an apartment anomaly that reduces stamina cost, then explain why I’m not rushing weekly/daily stamina. I break down the gacha and banner economy (90-pull guaranteed limited character, 200-pull skin, 50-pull base selector, and unlocking base characters via the Hunter Exchange with 720 fragments—about 30 pulls’ worth), plus how I’m planning picks like Daffodill and Sakiri for esper cycle synergy. I also cover events, City Tycoon mini-games and ratings, anomaly commissions, story/quests, dailies, and why the battle pass rewards aren’t necessary.
